digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md close workflow documentation
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit, when it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status
The precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and the require_completion_verification_for_close gate being on, but docs present it as unconditional
A referencing commit for the ticket OR any transitive descendant satisfies the precheck, not just the ticket itself
The rebar transition --ref flag enables closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree, but is completely absent from AGENTS.md
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism
